// about me

Who I am

Hey! I'm Cristian David Rojas Carvajal, a web developer with over five years in technology and four+ years focused on e-commerce and frontend development. I'm based between Colombia and Malta.

I specialize in Shopify and VTEX IO, building scalable storefronts and custom apps for retail and fashion brands across LATAM. My stack also covers React, TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, and GraphQL — from pixel-perfect UIs to backend integrations.

Passionate about performance, conversion-driven design, and clean code. Always learning, always shipping.
